generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential unique integers starting at 1, step 1; never NULL; never reused; never participate in any group-size, duplicate, or tie plan.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy an existing parent key value chosen uniformly; allow parent rows without children; do not produce NULL because these FKs are NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_amount: Uniform integer in [1, 100000]; amounts >= 0; allow duplicates where a DISTINCT-target pattern requires a 20-50% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_name: Random first + last name from a fixed pool of 40 names; length <= 255; duplicates allowed per the DISTINCT-target 20-50% share.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_code: Random choice from the column's enum pool; length <= 255.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Random choice from the column's enum pool, right-padded to declared length.
generic_sampling_rules.date_iso: Random date in [2016-01-01, 2018-12-31], format %Y-%m-%d; duplicates allowed where a DISTINCT-target pattern requires them.
generic_sampling_rules.date_order: When a table has a start/end or made/settled pair, sample the earlier date first, then the later date in [earlier, earlier+400 days]; applied only to independently sampled pairs, never to copied columns.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L, include L-1, L, L+1 in the pool.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_date: For each listed literal L, include L-1 day, L, L+1 day, keeping the table's date-order rule.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: For ORDER targets tie_on a column value: at least two rows share the value at the listed LIMIT rank. For ORDER targets tie_on COUNT(*)/COUNT(<col>): the value multiset is built so at least two distinct values share the rank-1 group frequency (do not merely duplicate the min/max value).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Nullable columns get a fixed share of NULL rows (~10%, at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance); the compact database per-column NULL share is unavailable so a fixed share is used. NOT NULL and PRIMARY KEY columns never get NULL. Planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_plan: Deterministically assign exactly one row per representative value, exactly two rows for a second representative, and >= 3 rows for a third representative; fill remaining rows without breaking the planted sizes. Never applied to PRIMARY KEY columns.
generic_sampling_rules.copy_from_parent: Copied columns are retrieved by looking up the specific parent row via the child's FK value (dict parent_key -> parent_row tuple), not by positional index; copied NULL propagates when the parent value is NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.generation_order: Fill parents before children: Customers -> Customer_Policies -> Claims -> Settlements -> Payments. Copied-column steps run after the child's FK value is fixed and are not overwritten by date-order or null-plan steps.
